validated_results.title: Manganese superoxide dismutase (MnSOD) polymorphism, alpha-tocopherol supplementation and prostate cancer risk in the alpha-tocopherol, beta-carotene cancer prevention study (Finland).

validated_results.title: Manganese superoxide dismutase (MnSOD) polymorphism, alpha-tocopherol supplementation and prostate cancer risk in the alpha-tocopherol, beta-carotene cancer prevention study (Finland).
validated_results.reason: Alpha-tocopherol supplementation is evaluated solely as an effect modifier of the MnSOD genotype association ("Supplementation with alpha-tocopherol had no impact on the MnSOD-prostate cancer association") without a population-wide vitamin E incidence estimate.

validated_results.title: Pharmacokinetics and tissue distribution of orally administered lycopene in male dogs.
validated_results.reason: This is an exclusively animal pharmacokinetic study of orally administered lycopene in male dogs with no human prostate cancer incidence data.

validated_results.title: Pharmacokinetics and tissue distribution of orally administered lycopene in male dogs.
validated_results.reason: The study measures lycopene pharmacokinetics and tissue distribution in dogs, so no human tomato-intake and prostate cancer incidence evidence exists.

validated_results.title: Prostate cancer in African American men is associated with downregulation of zinc transporters.
validated_results.reason: Mineral supplement intake is only mentioned speculatively as a future preventive possibility and was never measured as an exposure.

validated_results.title: Prostate cancer in African American men is associated with downregulation of zinc transporters.
validated_results.reason: The study compares zinc transporter (hZIP1/hZIP2) expression in prostate tumor tissues between racial groups, providing molecular/tissue evidence rather than any zinc exposure estimate for developing prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: Selenium and prevention of prostate cancer in high-risk men: the Negative Biopsy Study.
validated_results.reason: This is a trial design/accrual protocol description of the Negative Biopsy Study with no original prostate cancer incidence results reported.

validated_results.title: Toenail selenium levels and the subsequent risk of prostate cancer: a prospective cohort study.

validated_results.reason: Beta-carotene intake is examined only within "Analysis of effect modification" of the toenail selenium association, so no separable beta-carotene incidence estimate is available.
